caption: The drawing features a single, centrally placed silhouette of a figure in profile, facing left, depicted in a dark brown or rusty hue. The figure appears to be a person wearing a feathered headdress, a short skirt or tunic, and is holding a bow in their left hand, aiming an arrow with the right hand. The figure stands on an uneven base, also colored in the same shade. The background of the central rectangle is light beige, matching the surrounding border, but slightly warmer in tone. Under the silhouette, there is printed text reading “WEATHER-VANE 1/4 ACTUAL SIZE.” and below that, in smaller letters, “ELMER C. ANDERSON.” The entire drawing is framed by a simple double-lined rectangular border. The overall composition is vertically oriented, with the figure and text centered within the rectangular field.
title: Weather Vane
